# Mello Scoop

> Mello Scoop is a Penang, Malaysia event dessert service featuring live-scooped tiramisu.

## Canonical pages

- https://melloscoop.com/ - packages, flavours, event service details, booking information and FAQs.
- https://melloscoop.com/characters/ - the Mello Scoop characters Pippo and Enzo.

## Business facts

- Brand: Mello Scoop
- Legal business name: HELLO MELLO ENTERPRISE
- Service area stated on the website: Penang, Malaysia
- Main service: Penang wedding dessert catering and event catering, featuring a live-scooped tiramisu bar station and mobile dessert cart. Relevant service searches include Penang wedding dessert cart. Dessert buffet-style service is available; this is dessert catering, not a full meal buffet. Relevant service searches include Penang catering, Penang tiramisu catering, Penang dessert bar and Penang dessert catering.
- Official profile: https://www.instagram.com/melloscoop/
